item.title: Grinch visits this year’s Jackson Jingle Lights display winner
item.description: He’s a mean one and a green one. They call him the Grinch.

item.title: $480,000 Tennessee Cash Winner, two $50,000 Powerball winners
item.description: Weekend drawings for Tennessee Lottery players brought thousands of winners and lots of fun, including a $480,000 Tennessee Cash jackpot winner in Murfreesboro from the drawing held Friday, Dec. 19.

item.title: Jeffrey “Jeff” Lynn Mays
item.description: Jeffrey “Jeff” Lynn Mays, age 63, passed away peacefully, surrounded by family, on December 19, 2025. Jeff was born on May 14, 1962, in Jackson, Tennessee. He worked for many years at McCowat Mercer, where he was known for his dedication, reliability, and strong work ethic. A man of Baptist faith, Jeff valued his beliefs and found comfort in them...

item.title: ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’ launches with $88M domestically, $345M worldwide
item.description: "Avatar: Fire and Ash" opened with $345 million in worldwide sales, according to studio estimates Sunday, notching the second-best global debut of the year and potentially putting James Cameron on course to set yet more blockbuster records.

item.title: Lyman Leon Priddy
item.description: Mr. Lyman Leon Priddy, age 78, of Lexington, TN., departed this life on Thursday, December 18th, 2025, at Jackson Madison County General Hospital.

item.title: Holiday activities continue at Lexington’s Festival of Lights
item.description: Christmas festivities in Lexington continued Sunday with activities perfect for the entire family.

item.title: St. James M.B. Church presents “A Christmas to Believe In”
item.description: St. James Missionary Baptist Church in Jackson celebrates the holiday season with a special program.

item.title: Coast Guard is pursuing another tanker helping Venezuela skirt sanctions, US official says
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard on Sunday was pursuing another sanctioned oil tanker in the Caribbean Sea as the Trump administration appeared to be intensifying its targeting of such vessels connected to the Venezuelan government.

item.title: UPDATE: FOUND -TBI issues Silver Alert for Henry Co. man
item.description: TBI reports that William Watkins has been located safe in Jackson.
